readings.Aries: Your half-life in any comfortable situation is shorter than you'd like to admit. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Taurus: Something you own or have made is worth more than you've assigned it. Revalue. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Gemini: The distraction is real and deliberate. You know what you're distracting yourself from. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Cancer: Something is asking to be mourned before it can be moved past. Let it. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Leo: The thing you've been making is almost ready. Your perfectionism is the only thing delaying it. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Virgo: You've been waiting for everything to be in place before you begin. It won't ever all be in place. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Libra: There's a choice that's been framed as a compromise that actually requires you to simply choose. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Scorpio: Something is moving beneath the surface. You can feel it. Trust the feeling. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you've been calling freedom is starting to look like avoidance from a certain angle. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Capricorn: There is a risk worth taking that your caution has been routing around. Take it. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Aquarius: You have been right about this for a long time. It is not yet time to say 'I told you so.' The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: The boundary between you and other people is more permeable than average. This is your gift and your difficulty. What worked before will not work the same way this time.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
